commit.message:
fix(figure4): resolve block device from PCI BDF

Derive the kernel NVMe namespace from the configured PCI device and
fail closed unless it exposes exactly one block device. Remove the
independent block-device option so the format and bind targets cannot
diverge.

+def kernel_block_devices_for_bdf(bdf: str) -> list[Path]:
+    nvme_dir = Path("/sys/bus/pci/devices") / bdf / "nvme"
+    block_devices = []
+    for controller in sorted(nvme_dir.glob("nvme*")):
+        if not re.fullmatch(r"nvme\d+", controller.name):
+            continue
+        for namespace in sorted(controller.glob("nvme*n*")):
+            if re.fullmatch(r"nvme\d+n\d+", namespace.name):
+                block_devices.append(Path("/dev") / namespace.name)
+    return block_devices
+
+
+def require_one_kernel_block_device(bdf: str) -> str:
+    block_devices = kernel_block_devices_for_bdf(bdf)
+    if len(block_devices) != 1:
+        found = ", ".join(str(path) for path in block_devices) or "none"
+        raise SystemExit(
+            f"expected exactly one kernel NVMe namespace for {bdf}, found: {found}"
+        )
+    if not block_devices[0].is_block_device():
+        raise SystemExit(f"kernel NVMe namespace for {bdf} is not a block device: {block_devices[0]}")
+    return str(block_devices[0])
+
+
+def ensure_kernel_block_device(bdf: str) -> str:
+    driver = pci_driver_name(bdf)
+    block_devices = kernel_block_devices_for_bdf(bdf) if driver == "nvme" else []
+    if driver == "nvme" and len(block_devices) == 1 and block_devices[0].is_block_device():
+        return str(block_devices[0])
+    found = ", ".join(str(path) for path in block_devices) or "none"
+    print(
+        f"warning: {bdf} is not ready as exactly one kernel block device "
+        f"(driver={driver}, block_devices={found}); trying SPDK reset"
+    )
